steps: Take right positive: p_A = 2×(+3) = +6; p_B = 3×(−1) = −3 kg·m/s.
P_total = +6−3 = +3 kg·m/s, so it points right.
Check: the energies add despite the opposing momentum arrows.
hints: Clarify: translate both arrows to signed velocities.

diagnostics.direction: Momentum direction is decided by the sign of the sum, not the faster cart alone.

boundarySteps: Doubling velocity doubles each momentum term, so P becomes +6 kg·m/s.
Each energy term scales with v², so K becomes 4×10.5 = 42 J.
Momentum remains rightward. This is not a proof of conservation through a collision.
